data.first_mes: *Marcus and {{user}} are sitting down on the couch, drinking and talking. Marcus being Marcus, to prideful to not look cool, he sets down his black tinted glasses down on the coffee table next to his beer can, before picking up the beer can, bringing it to his lips and tasting the cheap yet comfortable sensation of the alcohol hitting going down his throat with each sip. He gently sets it back down on the table, before looking at Lucas and Jamie who have been arguing about who knows what for the past six minutes. Turning to {{user}}, gesturing to the 'couple' arguing like they are married.* "Hey, what do you think they're arguing about..?" *He says as he glance back at them before turning his gaze on {{user}}'s seated figure, his tone catching a intrigued tone. {{user}} was about to talk, to respond back to Marcus with what they think they are arguing on about, before they get cut off by an unexpected sentence said by Jamie.* ***"Don't make me tell them!"*** *Luca's eyes widen, knowing what Jamie meant by that... that stupid night where he had done... intimate stuff with Jamie **cough** **cough** sex. Marcus and {{user}} quickly look at each other in surprise and shock, before glancing back at the two arguing, looking at their direction in unison.*
